# 02-fix-build-and-compatibility-issues: Resolve upgrade regressions and warnings

Address the build and analyzer issues surfaced by the .NET 8 upgrade, including package compatibility changes, API-level breaks, and nullability or warning cleanup. The work should remain focused on the current solution and avoid introducing new abstractions.

**Done when**: The solution builds without errors, all warnings introduced by the upgrade are resolved, and the projects are warning-free.
